newsitem.title: USA: Norrell CFO eyes FY 98 EPS of $1.58.
newsitem.headline: Norrell CFO eyes FY 98 EPS of $1.58.

text.p: ATLANTA, April 16 (Reuter) The chief financial officer of Norrell Corp said he agrees with Wall Street's consensus estimate that the company will earn $0.31 a share in the second quarter that ends April 30, compared with $0.25 a share in the year earlier period.
The quarterly earnings announcement will be made on May 21, CFO Kent Garner said in an interview.
"Yes," he answered when asked if he agreed with the analysts' consensus estimate as reported by First Call.
